svg.title: BCM70015 post-host-STOP saved context comparison
svg.desc: Two native H.264 trials with four stages and two non-atomic passes each. Saved words at offsets 0 and 490 changed after the host STOP returned. Byte 490 remains bank count 6; adjacent byte 491 becomes disposition 10. No ARC completion, current state, source lease or pure pre-STOP staleness is certified.

g.text: STOP comparison: two changed saved words, not a completion token
Two H.264 trials · 256 × 96 · 180 frames each · 16 non-atomic saved snapshots
Same frozen D 033dc000 · all stage pairs match in both trials
34 saved descriptor flags remain zero; nine bank records unchanged. No bank/pool pointers followed.
572 / 572 frames: whole-pixel controls, firmware EOS and cleanup passed
Each observed trial: 560 reads / 4,416 B · no source-plane access or diagnostic target writes
Raw word fffffffe can be a picture-disposition sentinel; it is not a STOP reply.
No ARC ACK, guaranteed refresh, current state, source lease or pure pre-STOP staleness is certified.
